'''Getty''' (Japanese: '''チャッキー''' ''Chakkie'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]''. He is the brother of [[Angus]] and [[Betty]].

He and his siblings all entered the [[Clubsplosion]] tournament together. He eventually faced off against Betty in ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'' and lost.

Getty later made a brief appearance in ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', where he and Angus cheered his sister on before her battle with {{Ash}}.
